irisv.chat.transfer_requested: Transfer requested for %s. Subject to server validation.
irisv.chat.transfer_blocked: Transfer unavailable: check the workstation, ingredients and cursor.
irisv.chat.reload_failed: Reload incomplete. See latest.log for errors.
recip.irisv.pinned.title: Craft: %s
recip.irisv.wiki.properties: Properties: :food, :armor, :durability, :fuel. Fuel refers to the standard furnace. Multiple search terms retain OR matching.
recip.irisv.wiki.pinned: The frame button beside the book pins a text ingredient list on a black background during gameplay. Counters show available for this recipe / required quantities. Its size follows the text and its corner follows the tooltip position. Press again to unpin. One recipe per world session; hidden in menus and with F1.
recip.irisv.wiki.keys: Minecraft Options > Controls > Key Binds > IrisV: recipes and uses for the hovered item, pin the hovered recipe, toggle the pinned preview. New keys are unbound by default and do not trigger while typing in search. Existing mouse gestures are unchanged.
menu.irisv.tooltip.compatibility: Enables the HUD in screens declared by this integration. Transfers require explicit adapter support. Faulty integrations are disabled for this session and logged.
menu.irisv.tooltip.hud_category: Shows the catalog, favorites and search in this category. The global Inventory Recipes setting must also be enabled. Chests, barrels and Ender chests share one category.
menu.irisv.tooltip.recipe_availability: Shows a transfer arrow beside the bookmark. Green: click to fill and return to the workstation. Does not collect the result. Check fuel and output space.
recip.irisv.availability.station: Red: this recipe requires a different workstation.
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.transfer: Green arrow: click to place ingredients and return to the workstation. Shift + click fills the crafting table with the maximum possible quantity. Collect the result yourself. Fueled furnaces and brewing stands start normally; check fuel and output space. Red arrow: incompatible station, missing ingredients, blocked slots or occupied cursor.
recip.irisv.availability.missing: Transfer unavailable: missing ingredients, incompatible slots, occupied cursor or closed workstation. No items are moved.
menu.irisv.tooltip.inventory_search: In highlight mode (double-click the catalog search), outlines matching items in your inventory. No items are moved. Clearing the search removes the outlines.
menu.irisv.providers.title: IrisV - Mod Details
menu.irisv.tooltip.debug_chat: Shows IrisV debug messages in chat.
menu.irisv.tooltip.theme: Changes the visual theme for IrisV menus and overlays.
menu.irisv.tooltip.providers: Opens detailed settings for tooltips, inventory, recipes, and HUD indicators.
menu.irisv.tooltip.overlay: Enables the world hover information overlay.
menu.irisv.tooltip.position: Moves the overlay position on screen.
menu.irisv.tooltip.advanced_tooltips: Adds more details to tooltips when available.
menu.irisv.tooltip.compact: Reduces the display so it takes less space.
menu.irisv.tooltip.side: Chooses which side HUD indicators use.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.drops: Shows information for items on the ground.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.inventories: Shows useful contents for compatible inventories.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.recipes: Enables the inventory catalog and recipe interactions.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.hud: Enables or hides IrisV HUD indicators.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.tool_durabi: Shows the durability state of the equipped tool.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.durability_: Adds the exact remaining durability count.
recip.irisv.none: No recipe available for this item
recip.irisv.controls: Left click: crafting | Right click: uses
recip.irisv.give_controls: Shift + click: stack | Ctrl + click: 1 item | Ctrl + scroll up: +1
recip.irisv.wiki.title: IrisV Wiki
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.pages: Arrows or mouse wheel: change page in the list
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.categories: Category button: filters blocks, potions, food, tools...
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.favorites: Middle click an item: add or remove a favorite
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.eye: Eye: hide or show the catalog from inventory
recip.irisv.wiki.shift_click: Shift + click: give one stack in creative
recip.irisv.wiki.middle_click: Middle click: add or remove a favorite
recip.irisv.wiki.scroll: Mouse wheel: change page or scroll favorites
recip.irisv.wiki.search_text: Type a name to filter items
recip.irisv.wiki.search_highlight: Double click: yellow mode, dims non-matches
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.overlay: Overlay: shows info without opening a menu
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.providers: Mod Details: toggle blocks, entities, drops, fluids and inventories separately
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.advanced: Advanced: adds useful details when available
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.position: Position: moves the overlay to a corner or top center
recip.irisv.wiki.hud.indicators: Indicators: small visual reminders outside inventory
recip.irisv.wiki.hud.durability: Durability: shows tool state and remaining count
recip.irisv.wiki.hud.side: Side: places indicators on the left or right
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.survival: Left click: crafting. Right click: uses. Up to three recipes per page, with the catalog still accessible. No results means nothing opens. Escape returns directly to the inventory. Favorites search is independent from the catalog and is not saved.
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.creative: Creative: Shift + click gives a stack, Ctrl + click gives 1 item, Ctrl + scroll up adds 1 item without opening recipes. The book beside an output bookmarks the exact recipe. Filters: RECIPE, BLOCK, ITEM, GLOBAL. Hover: preview; scroll: saved variants; Shift + scroll: list; middle click: remove the displayed recipe.
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.hidden: Full inventory: extra items drop on the ground
irisv.support.title: Diagnostics & settings
irisv.settings.overwrite: Replace the existing irisv-settings.json with your current settings?
irisv.settings.confirm: Import irisv-settings.json? Settings will be applied and a backup created. Your favorites and their order will be preserved.
irisv.settings.failed: Operation failed: check the file, its format and folder permissions.
irisv.settings.scope: This file contains IrisV settings, without favorites or catalogue state. To import, place the received file here. Minecraft key bindings are not included. Pre-import backup: options.before-import.json.
irisv.compat.title: Compatibility
irisv.compat.vanilla: Vanilla: player inventory and supported standard-size containers. Visibility depends on categories enabled in Mod Details.
irisv.compat.limits: Only integrations registered with IrisV are listed. Available does not guarantee support for every screen or recipe in that mod. Failed integrations remain suspended until restart; see latest.log.
irisv.compat.transfer: Transfer depends on the adapter, workstation and server validation. Modded machines without an adapter receive no guessed transfers.
